headline: A 2007 order set out how the President read a Geneva Conventions rule on treating detainees, as applied to a CIA detention and interrogation program.
what_it_does: The order gave the President's official reading of Common Article 3 of the Geneva Conventions, which sets basic rules for the humane treatment of people held in certain armed conflicts. It applied that reading to a detention and interrogation program run by the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA). The title alone does not give the specific rules or limits the order set.

who_it_affects.how: Their detention and interrogation work was to follow the President's reading of Common Article 3 set out in this order.

who_it_affects.group: People held in the CIA detention program
who_it_affects.how: How they could be detained and questioned was governed by the standards described in this order.
